Class MapMaker

java.lang.Object
game.maps.MapMaker
public class MapMaker extends Object
A static utility factory class responsible for generating and configuring the game's levels.

This class hardcodes the data required for each map, including the physical path coordinates (waypoints), the starting money, player lives, and the specific composition and timing of enemy waves.

  • Method Details

    • buildWave

      private static EnemyType[] buildWave(Object... args)
      A helper method to concisely construct an array of enemies for a specific wave.

      This method accepts a variable number of arguments alternating between an EnemyType and an optional Integer representing the count. For example, buildWave(BASIC, 5, FAST, 2) will generate an array with 5 Basic enemies followed by 2 Fast enemies.

      Parameters:
      args - A sequence of EnemyType objects, optionally followed immediately by an Integer specifying how many of that enemy to spawn consecutively.
      Returns:
      A flat array of EnemyType representing the sequence of enemies for the wave.

    • getLevel1

      public static GameMap getLevel1()
      Generates the configuration for Level 1 ("Monkey Meadow").

      This is a beginner map with a simple, short path, higher starting money (500), a high number of lives (10), and 10 relatively easy waves.

      Returns:
      A fully populated GameMap instance for Level 1.

    • getLevel2

      public static GameMap getLevel2()
      Generates the configuration for Level 2 ("Lost Crevasse").

      This map features a highly complex, winding path with many waypoints. It offers less starting money (150), fewer lives (5), and 15 progressively harder waves introducing more flying and camo enemies.

      Returns:
      A fully populated GameMap instance for Level 2.

    • getLevel3

      public static GameMap getLevel3()
      Generates the configuration for Level 3 ("Cracked").

      This advanced map has a long, jagged path. It provides a moderate starting money pool (200), few lives (5), and 20 extremely challenging waves featuring heavy use of camo, flying, and regen enemies.

      Returns:
      A fully populated GameMap instance for Level 3.
